back_translation: Oh, that I had a travelers' lodge in the wilderness, so that I might abandon my people and depart from them, for they are all adulterers, a crowd of traitors.
They bend their tongues like a bow for falsehood; thus falsehood prevails over truth in the land. For they go from one evil to another, and they do not know Me, declares the LORD.
Let everyone be on guard against his neighbor, and do not trust any brother, for every brother is utterly deceitful and supplanting, and every friend goes about slandering.
Each one deceives his friend, and none speak the truth. They have trained their tongues to speak lies; they wear themselves out doing wrong.
You dwell in the midst of deceit; through that deceit they refuse to know Me, declares the LORD.
Therefore the LORD of Hosts says this: Behold, I will refine and test them, for how else can I act because of the daughter of My people?
Their tongue is a deadly arrow, speaking deceit. With his mouth he speaks peace to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets an ambush for him.
Shall I not punish them for these things? declares the LORD. And shall My soul not avenge itself on a nation such as this?

I will take up weeping and wailing for the mountains, and a dirge for the wilderness pastures, for they are scorched so that no one passes through, and the sound of livestock is not heard; from the birds of the sky to the beasts, they have all fled and gone.
I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a den of jackals, and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.
Who is the man wise enough to understand this? To whom has the mouth of the LORD spoken, that he may declare it — why the land is destroyed, scorched like a desert with no one passing through?
The LORD answered: It is because they forsook My law, which I set before them, and did not obey My voice or walk in it.
But they followed the stubbornness of their hearts and went after the Baals, as their fathers taught them.
Therefore the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says this: Behold, I will feed this people bitter wormwood, and I will make them drink poisoned water.
I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send the sword after them until I have destroyed them completely.
The LORD of Hosts says this: Consider carefully, and call for the wailing women to come, and send for the most skillful among them to come.
Let them hurry and take up a wailing over us, so that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids may stream with water.
For a sound of wailing is heard from Zion: 'How devastated we are! We are greatly ashamed, for we have left the land, because they have torn down our dwellings.'
O women, hear the word of the LORD, and let your ears receive the word of His mouth. Teach your daughters to wail, and one another to lament.
For death has climbed in through our windows; it has entered our fortresses, to cut off the children from the streets and the young men from the squares.
Declare that the LORD says this: The corpses of people will fall like dung on the open field, like a sheaf left behind the reaper, with no one to gather it.
The LORD says this: Let not the wise boast in his wisdom, let not the strong boast in his strength, let not the rich boast in his riches.

But let the one who boasts boast in this: that he understands and knows Me, that I am the LORD who exercises steadfast love, justice, and righteousness on the earth, for in these I delight, declares the LORD.
Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh —

Egypt, Judah, Edom, the Ammonites, Moab, and all who clip the hair at their temples, who dwell in the wilderness; for all these nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.
